title: Where leads actually come from
transcript:
Consultant: Do you know which channels bring in your best leads?
Client: We have no idea, and marketing keeps asking. Right now the rep types
whatever they remember into the notes field.
Consultant: So there is no structured source?
Client: None. We need a lead source field on the lead, as a picklist, with
web, referral, event and outbound.
Consultant: Four values then.
Client: Four. If we need more later we will add them.

expected.note: Picklist on Lead with four values, all stated.
